styleFormula: Photoreal cinematic reconstruction with recognizable Pokémon silhouettes and expressive proportions. Organic surfaces have fine, restrained biological detail; shells, eyes, masonry and vegetation have distinct physically based responses. Cool blue creature colors contrast with warm earth and muted green scenery. Natural daylight and soft indirect fill reveal form without hiding defects. Use coherent world scale, legible combat silhouettes and three-dimensional geometry that holds up from the exploration and battle cameras.
note: Source composite is an exact pixel crop of the already-reconstructed ROM map, not generated geometry.
